# Website Vikreta
> Website Vikreta is an AI-first web and automation studio. The team is based in Pune, India and works with clients worldwide, with coverage during US hours. We build websites, apps, and AI automation systems for businesses in the US, UK and other Western markets.

## AI Automations

- [Workflow Automation](https://www.websitevikreta.com/services/ai-automations/workflow-automation): Connect CRMs, documents and inboxes so routine work runs without hand-offs.
  - [CRM automation](https://www.websitevikreta.com/services/ai-automations/workflow-automation/crm-automation)
  - [Document data extraction](https://www.websitevikreta.com/services/ai-automations/workflow-automation/document-data-extraction)
  - [AI teammates](https://www.websitevikreta.com/services/ai-automations/workflow-automation/ai-teammates)
- [AI Voice Agents](https://www.websitevikreta.com/services/ai-automations/ai-voice-agents): AI phone agents that answer calls, qualify leads and book appointments.
  - [AI receptionist](https://www.websitevikreta.com/services/ai-automations/ai-voice-agents/ai-receptionist)
  - [Outbound lead qualification](https://www.websitevikreta.com/services/ai-automations/ai-voice-agents/outbound-lead-qualification)
- [WhatsApp Automation](https://www.websitevikreta.com/services/ai-automations/whatsapp-automation): Lead follow-up, reminders and support on WhatsApp.
  - [WhatsApp lead follow-up](https://www.websitevikreta.com/services/ai-automations/whatsapp-automation/whatsapp-lead-follow-up)
  - [Appointment reminders](https://www.websitevikreta.com/services/ai-automations/whatsapp-automation/appointment-reminders)
- [HR Automation](https://www.websitevikreta.com/services/ai-automations/hr-automation): Offer letters, onboarding, screening and contracts.
  - [Offer letter automation](https://www.websitevikreta.com/services/ai-automations/hr-automation/offer-letter-automation)
  - [Employee onboarding automation](https://www.websitevikreta.com/services/ai-automations/hr-automation/employee-onboarding-automation)
- [AI UGC Ads](https://www.websitevikreta.com/services/ai-automations/ai-ugc-ads): UGC-style video ads and spokesperson videos from product images.
  - [AI UGC video ads](https://www.websitevikreta.com/services/ai-automations/ai-ugc-ads/ai-ugc-video-ads)
  - [AI spokesperson videos](https://www.websitevikreta.com/services/ai-automations/ai-ugc-ads/ai-spokesperson-videos)
- [Content Automation](https://www.websitevikreta.com/services/ai-automations/content-automation): SEO blog posts, social content and repurposing.
  - [SEO blog content](https://www.websitevikreta.com/services/ai-automations/content-automation/seo-blog-content)

  - [Proposal generation](https://www.websitevikreta.com/services/ai-automations/proposal-automation/proposal-generation)

## About

Website Vikreta designs and builds fast websites and AI automation for small and mid-sized businesses. The team is in Pune, India. Clients are in the US, UK and elsewhere, and the team covers US working hours.

We run our own company on these automations. Our AI agents are named Meher (HR), Ira (content and UGC) and Arjun (sales and finance).

## Clients and results

- Simpli Home: AI UGC ads. About 20 hours a week of ad production work cut to 1.
- SBP
- Blancora
